name: Camp Urbie at Urban Air Adventure Park – Warwick, RI
operator_name: Urban Air Adventure Park (an Unleashed Brands company)
description_short: An indoor day camp at the Urban Air trampoline and adventure park in Warwick, with guided activities, games, competitions and open play. Full-day and half-day (morning or afternoon) options are offered during school breaks and days off.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds or exchanges. Camp is not transferable, and no credits are given for missed days. Payment is charged to the credit card entered at booking.
